Title: [LSJ] Path of Death and the Soul timing.

Messages.Author: Jadasc
Messages.Body:
1. A minion with basic fortitude takes an action that causes a minion
controlled by another Methuselah to be burned. Can Path of Death and
the Soul be tapped in time to add basic celerity to that minion so
that Forced March can be played to untap it?

2. If the action was diablerie, would this happen before or after the
blood hunt?

Messages.Body:

Another theoretically neat combo I confirmed privately with LSJ a few
months ago was: tapping PoDaS when burning your own minion (e.g through
Daring the Dawn) when burning another minion (e.g by Eldest Command
Undeath) to move a skill card before applying the aggravted damage
applies and therefore trigger the Soul Gem on the Vampire.

Haven´t found a good deck with it (yet), though. Perhaps one of you can.
